topic: Setting Up the School Lunch Account and Menu Choices

script.title: SCHOOL LUNCH SETUP
script.scene_zh: 學校餐廳 · 開立午餐帳戶
script.story_hook: A new lunch account, a picky kid, one kind server.
script.intro_zh: 一個全新的午餐帳戶、一個挑食的孩子、一位和藹的供餐人員。
script.welcome_en: Hi, welcome to the school lunch line. Listen for everyday payment words.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，歡迎來到學校午餐隊伍。留意日常付款的說法。
script.outro: And that's an account set up right. Try the money words once more.
script.outro_zh: 一個帳戶就這樣正確開好了。再把付款相關的字多唸一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.title_quote: half of us forget on Fridays
script.char_a_description: a busy mother in her mid thirties with chin-length straight black hair in a quick ponytail, small gold earrings, a red plaid flannel shirt, black leggings, and a slim build
script.char_b_description: a friendly lunch server in his twenties with a short faded black haircut, a neat beard, a powder blue uniform shirt, a white hair net, a name tag, and a tall thin build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I need to set up a lunch account.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪ nid tə sɛt ʌp ə lʌntʃ əˈkaʊnt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我需要幫孩子開一個午餐帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, is this your first child here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɪz ðɪs jɔɹ ˈfɝst ˈtʃaɪld hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，這是你們在這所學校的第一個孩子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, my little one starts second grade today.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs maɪ ˈlɪɾəl wʌn stɑɹtz ˈsɛkənd ɡɹeɪ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我家寶貝今天上二年級。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then welcome! I'll open it in a minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ˈwɛlkəm aɪl ˈoʊpən ɪt ɪn ə ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 那歡迎！我一分鐘就幫你開好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great. Do we use an app for this?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du wi ˈjuz ən ˈæp fɚ ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我們是用 App 操作嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do, it's called School Lunch Pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi du ɪts ˈkɔld skul ˈlʌntʃ ˈpeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，那個 App 叫 School Lunch Pay。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, how do I add money to it?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ haʊ du aɪ æd ˈmʌni tə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 好，我要怎麼把錢加進去？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap load, then card or bank.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdʒʌst tæp ˈloʊd ðɛn ˈkɑɹd ɔɹ bæŋk/
dialogue.zh: 只要按儲值，然後選信用卡或銀行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Simple enough. What's the balance right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl ɪˈnʌf wɑts ðə ˈbæləns ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 夠簡單。那現在餘額是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's at zero until your first payment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts æt ˈzɪɹoʊ əˈntɪl jɔɹ fɝst ˈpeɪmənt/
dialogue.zh: 在你第一次付款之前都是零。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. How much should I load today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt haʊ mʌtʃ ʃʊd aɪ loʊd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 了解。我今天該先存多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most folks start with about twenty dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst foʊks stɑɹt wɪð əˈbaʊt ˈtwɛnti ˈdɑlərz/
dialogue.zh: 大多數人會先存大約二十塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, will that last a whole week?
dialogue.phonetic: /həm wɪl ðæt ˈlæst ə ˈhoʊl ˈwik/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那些能撐一整週嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Easily, meals are three forty each.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈiːzəli ˈmilz ɑɹ ˈθɹi ˈfɔɹti itʃ/
dialogue.zh: 一定夠，每餐三塊四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, cheaper than I thought, nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈtʃipɚ ðæn aɪ θɔt naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 噢，比我以為的便宜，真好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. Any milk choice she should know?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ˈɛni mɪlk tʃɔɪs ʃi ʃud noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是啊。她該知道有哪些牛奶可選嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Milk? Um, does she pick that herself?
dialogue.phonetic: /mɪlk ʌm dʌz ʃi pɪk ðæt hɚˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 牛奶？嗯，那個是她自己挑嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, plain, chocolate, or a lactose free one.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pleɪn ˈtʃɑkələt ɔɹ ə lækˈtoʊs fɹi wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 可以，原味、巧克力，或無乳糖的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can't do plain milk, her tummy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kænt du pleɪn mɪlk hɚ ˈtʌmi/
dialogue.zh: 她不能喝原味牛奶，她的肚子會不舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the lactose free carton is best.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə lækˈtoʊs fɹi ˈkɑɹtn ɪz bɛst/
dialogue.zh: 那無乳糖的紙盒裝最適合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect, thank you for asking about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɝfɪkt θæŋk ju fɚ ˈæskɪŋ əˈbaʊt ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，謝謝你特地問這個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Does she need a form for anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs dʌz ʃi nid ə fɔɹm fɚ ˈɛniˌθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣。她有任何表格要填嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Free lunch? Where do I find that form?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈfɹi ˈlʌntʃ wɛɹ du aɪ ˈfaɪnd ðæt ˈfɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 免費午餐？我要去哪裡找那張表？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll print it, or there's one online too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl prɪnt ɪt ɔɹ ðɛɹz wʌn ˌɑnˈlaɪn tu/
dialogue.zh: 我可以印一張，線上也有一份。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, I'd rather do it on paper today.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm aɪd ɹɑðɚ du ɪt ɑn ˈpeɪpɚ təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我今天還是想用紙本填。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No problem, here's one right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈpɹɑbləm hɪɹz wʌn ɹaɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，這裡就有一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks. Do I fill out the whole thing?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks du aɪ ˈfɪl aʊt ðə ˈhoʊl ˈθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。是要整份都填嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the income part and your signature.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ði ˈɪnkʌm pɑɹt ænd jɔɹ ˈsɪɡnətʃɚ/
dialogue.zh: 只要填收入那欄，還有你的簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Will she get told she's on free lunch?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ wɪl ʃi ɡɛt toʊld ʃiɹ ɑn fɹi lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 好。會不會有人知道她在吃免費午餐？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, it's private, nobody sees a difference.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ɪts ˈpɹaɪvət ˈnoʊbədi siz ə ˈdɪfɹəns/
dialogue.zh: 不會，這是隱密的，沒人看得出差別。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That matters a lot, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈmæɾɚz ə lɑt ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 這對我們很重要，老實說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I get it, I have kids too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɡɛt ɪt aɪ hæv ˈkɪdz tu/
dialogue.zh: 我懂，我也有小孩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the account is open, what's next?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ði əˈkaʊnt ɪz ˈoʊpən wɑts nɛkst/
dialogue.zh: 那帳戶開好了，接下來呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set up balance alerts on the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ʌp ˈbæləns əˈlɝts ɑn ði æp/
dialogue.zh: 在 App 上設定餘額提醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alerts? Like a text when money runs low?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlɝts laɪk ə tɛkst wɛn ˈmʌni ɹʌnz loʊ/
dialogue.zh: 提醒？像是錢快用完了會發簡訊給我？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, it pings you at five dollars left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ɪt pɪŋz ju æt faɪv ˈdɑlərz lɛft/
dialogue.zh: 就是，剩下五塊時會通知你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's so helpful for a forgetful parent.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts soʊ ˈhɛlpfəl fɚ ə fɚˈɡɛtfəl ˈpɛɹənt/
dialogue.zh: 對健忘的家長來說太有用了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Trust me, half of us forget on Fridays.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɹʌst mi hæf əv ʌs fɚˈɡɛt ɑn ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪz/
dialogue.zh: 相信我，我們有一半人星期五都會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, I already forgot last Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪ ɔlˈɛdi fɚˈɡɑt læst ˈfɹaɪˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我上週五就忘了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're not alone. Now, hot lunch or just snacks?
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ nɑt əˈloʊn naʊ hɑt lʌntʃ ɔɹ dʒʌst snæks/
dialogue.zh: 不只你這樣。現在，要吃熱食還是只吃點心？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She eats a full meal, for sure.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈits ə ˈfʊl ˈmil fɚ ˈʃʊɹ/
dialogue.zh: 她會吃完整份餐點，一定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the tray includes a fruit too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðə tɹeɪ ɪnˈkludz ə fɹut tu/
dialogue.zh: 很好，托盤裡還附一份水果。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does she trade fruit for another veggie?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ʃi tɹeɪd fɹut fɚ əˈnʌðɚ ˈvɛdʒi/
dialogue.zh: 她可以用水果換別種蔬菜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only once, but carrots swap easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌns bʌt ˈkɑɹəts swɑp ˈizi/
dialogue.zh: 只能換一次，但紅蘿蔔很好換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, she lives on carrots lately.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ʃi lɪvz ɑn ˈkɑɹəts leɪtli/
dialogue.zh: 哈，她最近幾乎只吃紅蘿蔔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, then we're almost done here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt ðɛn wɪɹ ˈɔlmoʊst dʌn hɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那我們這邊快弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I get a receipt for this payment?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɛt ə ɹɪˈsit fɚ ðɪs ˈpeɪmənt/
dialogue.zh: 我這筆付款會收到收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app emails one right after you pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ˈimeɪlz wʌn ɹaɪt ˈæftɚ ju peɪ/
dialogue.zh: 付完錢，App 會立刻寄一封到你的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And if we move schools later on?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ɪf wi muv skulz ˈleɪɾɚ ɑn/
dialogue.zh: 那如果我們之後換學校呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any leftover balance moves with her, don't worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛni ˌlɛfˈoʊvɚ ˈbæləns muvz wɪð hɚ doʊnt ˈwɝi/
dialogue.zh: 沒用完的餘額會跟著她轉過去，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That's good to know, thank you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ˈɡʊd tə ˈnoʊ θæŋk ju/
dialogue.zh: 知道這個真好，謝謝你。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here's her PIN for the cash register line.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪɹz hɚ pɪn fɚ ðə kæʃ ˈɹɛdʒəstɚ laɪn/
dialogue.zh: 這是她的編號，在結帳線報數字就行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She just says a number at the counter?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi dʒʌst sɛz ə ˈnʌmbɚ æt ðə ˈkaʊntɚ/
dialogue.zh: 她只要在櫃台報一個數字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep, or she scans her little hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp ɔɹ ʃi skænz hɚ ˈlɪɾəl hænd/
dialogue.zh: 是啊，她也可以用小手掃一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her hand? Oh, the fingerprint thing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɚ hænd oʊ ðə ˈfɪŋɡɚˌpɹɪnt θɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 她的手？噢，是指紋那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's the fastest, kids love using it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæts ðə ˈfæstɪst ˈkɪdz lʌv ˈjuzɪŋ ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那個最快，小孩都很愛用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She'll be so proud today, I bet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃil bi soʊ pɹaʊd təˈdeɪ aɪ bɛt/
dialogue.zh: 她今天一定會很驕傲，我打賭。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sure she will. Anything else at all?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm ʃʊɹ ʃi wɪl ˈɛniθɪŋ ɛls æt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 她一定會的。還想問點別的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nope, I think we're all set now.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊp aɪ ˈθɪŋk wɪɹ ˈɔl ˈsɛt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 沒了，我想我們都弄好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful, enjoy your first lunch day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌndɚfəl ɛnˈdʒɔɪ jɔɹ fɝst lʌntʃ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，享受她的第一個午餐日吧。

script.youtube_title_en: "Half of Us Forget on Fridays" — Setting Up a School Lunch Account
script.youtube_description:
「我們有一半人星期五都會忘」——開學第一天，怎麼幫孩子開一個學校午餐帳戶？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在學校餐廳的供餐台。

你會聽到：用 App 儲值、確認餘額、每餐多少錢；牛奶有哪些選項、乳糖不耐怎麼選；申請免費午餐表格怎麼填、會不會讓同學看出來；還有餘額不足提醒、換學校時餘額怎麼跟著走。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與日常短句，反覆出現的是美國家長真實的語感：um、so、oh、ha、yep。聽完你就會用：I need to set up、How much should、Does she need、Where do I find。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"Half of us forget on Fridays" — how do you open a school lunch account on the very first day? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set right at the cafeteria counter.

You will hear: loading money through the app, checking the balance and price per meal, choosing among milk options for a tummy that can't do lactose, filling the free lunch form without anyone noticing, setting low-balance alerts, and moving the balance to a new school.

Everything stays in A2-level words, with the small talk parents really use: um, so, oh, ha, yep. By the end you'll own phrases like I need to set up, How much should, and Where do I find.

The last chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
開學第一天，午餐要吃什麼、錢要怎麼儲值，全靠一個 App？免費午餐的表格會不會讓同學看出孩子吃免費午餐？餘額快用完了怎麼知道？

這一集帶大家走進學校餐廳的供餐台，從開戶、儲值、選牛奶，一路聽到免費午餐申請、餘額提醒與換學校轉餘額，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🍎 開戶句：Hi, I need to set up a lunch account.
💳 儲值句：Just tap load, then card or bank.
🥛 選牛奶：She can't do plain milk, her tummy.
🔔 餘額提醒：it pings you at five dollars left.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 oh、yep、ha 這些自然語感唸到脫口而出。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。只要跟著這位媽媽在供餐台前一問一答，下次自己替孩子開戶，話就從嘴邊自己冒出來。

祝你家寶貝午餐天天安心吃飽。
